reviews.t: This place was so awesome they went above and beyond. Without them I just don't know how me and my brother would have made it through the Strom
Wonderful organization. Well, put together and lots still to give out. I donated pillows in cases for kids today. Everyone was extremely helpful and informative.

Had a chance to link up with the team from Hearts with Hands for a week of hurricane recovery volunteering. Had 3 adults and 4 college students with me and we were blown away by this organization! Greg, Robert, and Doug were so patient with our group as many of us did not have construction experience, but they gave each of us meaningful tasks that matched our levels of ability. Every one of our team learned something from these guys that we are able to take away from this experience and use in life. Robert is a man after God's own heart who went out of his way time and again to ensure that everything in our power was done for the homeowners who we served! The name of this organization says it all! We look forward to linking up with this team again in the future!

They are wonderful. I just came from where they're set up not far from Nichols, SC and Fair Bluff,NC, two small towns who were the hardest hit by Hurricane Matthew with both towns entirely flooded. Hearts With Hands are warm, giving folks who love God and have given out 10,000 food relief boxes in the last 3 weeks. We were invited back tonight for supper and worship under the big tent. We're so thankful for them as we lost food due to several days without power. May God bless those who give through Heart with Hands. They're here in our time of need.
